solutions.title: Frequency counts
solutions.strategy: Count each character and use every even pair, plus one center character if any odd count exists.

timeComplexity.explanation: The string is scanned once and the count table is scanned once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The table stores one count per distinct character.

solutions.title: Toggle odd set
solutions.strategy: Track characters with odd parity; every second occurrence contributes a pair immediately.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character performs constant-time set work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The odd set holds at most one entry per distinct character.
